جَرْشٌ The sound of a viper's coming forth form the skin [or slough] when the former rubs, or grates, one part against another. (K.) ―
-b2- And The sound of a viper's fangs, when they rub, or grate [together]. (TA.) ―
-b3- And The sound arising from eating a rough thing: or this is with س. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
